The values increase in increments of 1000, with tick marks indicating 0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, and 10000. The bar corresponding to “Administrative” reaches a height of approximately 6472 tokens, while the bar for “Religion” reaches approximately 1889 tokens. The bar for “Non-fiction” appears to have a value of 354, and the bar for “Fiction” shows a value of 387, the bar for “Law” shows a value of 1626, “News” has a value of 1568, “Science” has a value of 32, and "Blogs" has a value of 0.
